    • metadata

      default <T> Optional<T> metadata(String key, TypeRef<T> typeRef)
      Returns a type-safe metadata value for the given key.

      This method retrieves the metadata object and attempts to cast it to the specified type.

      Type Parameters:
      T - the type of the metadata value
      Parameters:
      key - the metadata key
      typeRef - a TypeRef representing the desired type of the value
      Returns:
      an Optional containing the metadata value cast to the specified type, or an empty Optional if the key is not found or the value cannot be cast.
